# Indicator computation and result handles

<!-- Generated by scripts/core_docs.py; edit the source of truth and regenerate. -->

Strategies register indicators through self.ta; handles follow the run cursor and explicit conversions create snapshots. Use compute for offline calculations.

[Usage guide](../guides/indicators.md) · [Compatibility and internal entries](classification.md)

<a id="openbacktesting-indicators-default-cache-bytes"></a>

## DEFAULT_CACHE_BYTES

Default retained-byte budget for one indicator cache, not a process memory limit.

`openbacktesting.indicators.DEFAULT_CACHE_BYTES` = `67108864`。

<a id="openbacktesting-indicators-indicatorcache"></a>

## IndicatorCache

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.indicators.IndicatorCache`

```python

```

Source: `src/openbacktesting/indicators/runtime.py`。

## catalog

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.indicators.catalog`

```python
openbacktesting.indicators.catalog()
```

Return a tuple of all reviewed definitions, including deferred entries that cannot be called.

Returns:
    tuple: Indicator definitions; check status before calling, and expect the count to vary with the reviewed catalog.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/indicators/runtime.py`。

<a id="openbacktesting-indicators-compute"></a>

## compute

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.indicators.compute`

```python
openbacktesting.indicators.compute(indicator, frame, *, parameters=None, backend=None, inputs=None, cache=None, cursor=None, required_outputs=None)
```

Compute reviewed indicators in bulk on explicit market data and return read-only result handles.

Args:
    indicator: Full catalog ID.
    frame: pandas DataFrame; index and inputs must satisfy the indicator contract.
    parameters: Parameter mapping; reject unknown keys, invalid types, and invalid relationships.
    backend: Backend identifier; None uses the catalog default without silent fallback.
    inputs: Mapping from indicator inputs to market-data column names or single channels from the same run.
    cache: Optional IndicatorCache; None recomputes each time.
    cursor: Internal framework run cursor; None for standalone computation.
    required_outputs: Canonical required output names; an empty list disables warmup gating.

Returns:
    IndicatorHandle: Single- or multi-channel handle with valid/ready masks and provenance metadata.

Raises:
    IndicatorError: Failure in ID, parameters, backend, inputs, outputs, or computation.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/indicators/runtime.py`。

<a id="openbacktesting-indicators-describe"></a>

## describe

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.indicators.describe`

```python
openbacktesting.indicators.describe(indicator)
```

Look up an indicator definition by stable ID without computing it.

Args:
    indicator: Full catalog ID, such as ta.ema.

Returns:
    IndicatorSpec: Definition of parameter domains, outputs, status, and semantic version.

Raises:
    IndicatorError: code is unknown-indicator when the ID does not exist.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/indicators/runtime.py`。

<a id="openbacktesting-indicators-methods-technicalanalysis-is-cross"></a>

## is_cross

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.indicators.methods.TechnicalAnalysis.is_cross`

```python
openbacktesting.indicators.methods.TechnicalAnalysis.is_cross(self, left: collections.abc.Sequence[float] | numpy.ndarray | pandas.Series | openbacktesting.indicators.types.IndicatorHandle | float, right: collections.abc.Sequence[float] | numpy.ndarray | pandas.Series | openbacktesting.indicators.types.IndicatorHandle | float) -> bool
```

Check whether either-direction crossing occurs on the last currently visible bar.

Args:
    left: Single-channel handle, numeric sequence, or numeric constant; column-name strings are not accepted.
    right: Single-channel handle, numeric sequence, or numeric constant; constants act as fixed thresholds.

Returns:
    Python bool. Equality is allowed on the preceding bar; current equality is not a crossing.
    False with fewer than two bars or NaN/infinity in either of the last two bars.
    Calls in next read only the currently visible input prefix, without registering indicators or affecting warmup.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/indicators/predicates.py`。

<a id="openbacktesting-indicators-methods-technicalanalysis-is-crossover"></a>

## is_crossover

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.indicators.methods.TechnicalAnalysis.is_crossover`

```python
openbacktesting.indicators.methods.TechnicalAnalysis.is_crossover(self, left: collections.abc.Sequence[float] | numpy.ndarray | pandas.Series | openbacktesting.indicators.types.IndicatorHandle | float, right: collections.abc.Sequence[float] | numpy.ndarray | pandas.Series | openbacktesting.indicators.types.IndicatorHandle | float) -> bool
```

Check whether the current left value is strictly above the right, with the preceding left value at or below the right.

Args:
    left: Single-channel handle, numeric sequence, or numeric constant; column-name strings are not accepted.
    right: Single-channel handle, numeric sequence, or numeric constant; constants act as fixed thresholds.

Returns:
    Python bool. Read only the last two bars; False with fewer than two bars or NaN/infinity.
    Valid positions match the ta.crossover sequence; no registration, and calls in next are allowed.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/indicators/predicates.py`。
